Required proof: All four old-code Store causal failures have now been reproduced using actual epochs, original stamps and current read entitlements. No decoded-media claim comes from those units. The fixed implementation must preserve unchanged flows while each real writer is held, permanently fence affected connections and refuse altered identities, rows, receipts, expiry, cancellation and cross-Store/SQL-unit misuse. Cleanup must preserve a valid existing appearance and withdraw invalid pending claims. Independent review and unit controls precede the entire regression cohort, actual Opus/VP8 programmes and unchanged quality limits.
State: implementing; implementation: Local OLD49 reproduced the exact healthy-epoch revocation in all four writer paths, with original source fencing and cleanup controls intact. Connection-specific scopes, same-transaction exact row permits and bounded pending-handoff appearance continuity are drafted. Opaque Store witnesses bind current authority and immutable receipts; broader lifecycle changes retain broad fencing. The production batch is not applied or verified yet. Blockers: B191. Dependencies: P1.1.
Checkpoint: The last complete regression executed all 241 cases: 239 passed and two full media programmes failed video FPS. Audio, Data, four moves per programme and both Session cleanup checks passed; the 24 FPS requirement is unchanged. Diagnostics account for the retained-video packet loss before packetization, at Core forwarding and authorization/age checks. A new local Store run reproduced the overbroad invalidation in all four paths: physical commit, public activation, original cleanup and replacement cleanup. All four causal tests failed at their intended old-code oracle, within the same two-second observation window, after owners were joined; these are confirmed bug reproductions, not media or matrix passes. The changed connection remained fenced while the unaffected original epoch was wrongly revoked. The same tests also exposed appearance changes during pending handoff settlement. Resource is implementing connection-specific writer scopes and bounded appearance continuity; Root and Media are building/reviewing exact same-transaction SQL permits backed by sealed Store provenance, complete authorization reads and exact affected writes. Fixture owns the regression and refusal controls. No narrower permit can grant new media, resurrect an epoch, extend a lease or replay a physical effect. Units and the complete regression cohort precede ARM shipping and all 32 matrix cells. The last matrix remains v215 at 0/32; no new matrix run is claimed. G6-054 remains parked.
